# Google Translate

> > Google Translate: Free multilingual translation service supporting 100+ languages with text, speech, image, document, and website translation across web and mobile platforms.

Google Translate provides instant translation capabilities through its web interface and mobile apps (Android/iOS), featuring advanced tools like camera translation, offline mode, voice input, conversation mode, and document translation. The service supports community contributions and offers business integration options.

## Key Topics

- Google Translate
- Camera translation
- Offline translation
- Voice translation
- Conversation mode
- Document translation
- Website translation
- Mobile app (Android/iOS)
- Transcribe feature
- Language translation
- Community contributions
- 100+ languages
- Real-time translation
- Text translation
- Speech recognition

## Core Translation Service

- [Google Translate](https://translate.google.com): Main translation service: instant text, phrases, web pages in 100+ languages
- [Google Translate Community](https://translate.google.com/community): Google Translate community page for multilingual collaboration
- [Google Traduttore (Italian)](https://translate.google.com/intl/it/about/index.html): Italian main page: camera, offline, transcription on Android/iOS devices
- [Google Переводчик (Russian)](https://translate.google.com/intl/ru/about/index.html): Russian main page: speech, text, images, documents, websites translation
- [Google Translate (Marathi)](https://translate.google.com/intl/mr/about/index.html): Marathi main page: multilingual translation for text, speech, images, docs
- [Google Translate (Cebuano)](https://translate.google.com/intl/ceb/about/index.html): Cebuano main page: Android/iOS app with offline, camera, voice translation
- [Google Translate (Shona)](https://translate.google.com/intl/sn/about/index.html): Shona main page: camera, offline, voice, conversation, website translation
- [Diphetolelo Tsa Google (Sesotho)](https://translate.google.com/intl/st/about/index.html): Sesotho main page: Transcribe feature, Android/iOS app with camera, offline

## Translation Features & Guides

- [Google преводилац (Serbian)](https://translate.google.com/intl/sr/about/contribute.html): Serbian guide to Google Translate features: camera, offline, voice, docs
- [Google Translate Features (Marathi)](https://translate.google.com/intl/mr/about/contribute.html): Marathi guide to translation features: camera, offline, voice, documents
- [Google Translate Contribution (Pashto)](https://translate.google.com/intl/ps/about/contribute.html): Pashto contribution guide for community translation and crowdsourcing
- [Whakamāori Google (Māori)](https://translate.google.com/intl/mi/about/contribute.html): Māori language guide: offline, camera, voice, conversation mode features
- [Google Translate Features (Zulu)](https://translate.google.com/intl/zu/about/contribute.html): Zulu guide: Android/iOS features including camera, offline, conversation

## Business & Enterprise

- [Google Tərcümə Business (Azerbaijani)](https://translate.google.com/intl/az/about/forbusiness.html): Azerbaijani business features: Android/iOS apps, camera, offline translation
- [Traductor de Google Business (Catalan)](https://translate.google.com/intl/ca/about/forbusiness.html): Catalan business features: Transcriu, camera, offline on Android/iOS
